svg.title: Uploading a 24 MiB file as six 4 MiB blocks
svg.desc: Blocks 2 and 5 are already stored, so they are skipped. Attempt 1 sends blocks 1 and 3, then the connection drops during block 4. On attempt 2 the server lists only blocks 4 and 6 as missing, so only those are sent. 16 MiB of 24 MiB is uploaded.
svg.text: after the drop the device asks again; the server
now lists only blocks 4 and 6 as missing
uploaded in total: blocks 1, 3, 4, 6 = 16 MiB of 24
